svg.title: A validation fold should stay unseen

g.text: A validation fold should stay unseen
Feature selection belongs inside each training fold.
LEAKED: all samples + labels → select genes → split → train / validate
Validation labels already influenced the gene list.
TRAIN: training samples → select genes → fit scaler → fit classifier
VALIDATE: held-out samples → apply fitted selector + scaler → predict
Repeat the training workflow independently for every fold.
